title: Azure Blob container listing in a response

remediation: Disable anonymous container access and serve files through short-lived signed URLs.
limitation: One response body, first 32,768 bytes. It matches the enumeration document from the blob host; it cannot tell whether the value behind the marker is live or whether the page needs authentication.

fp: A page that documents the storage API without a listing is not reported.
recordDesc: An Azure blob enumeration document from the storage endpoint in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The listing names every blob in the container, so a container that was meant to be private becomes an index of documents, dumps and exports that can then be fetched one by one.
applicability: Deployments that render an Azure blob enumeration document from the storage endpoint into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The listing names every blob in the container, so a container that was meant to be private becomes an index of documents, dumps and exports that can then be fetched one by one.

Disable anonymous container access and hand out short-lived signed URLs.
